notes.title: Update 7.3
notes.content:
Here is update 7.3.
175 new images and 500 lines of code that continue the male route after where it previously ended, This puts the MC right up to where the night fun starts, yes it will literally start right then... ;), This update will seem short as its just getting it to where all the night fun starts, you may want to wait a few weeks if you want a longer play.
The reason I am pushing updates weekly is to show that progress is being made, if I force myself to update everyone, then I will ;)

New Content/Code Fixes/Changes
[list]
[*] 175 new Images
[*] 500 lines of code (Taking the male route to a total of 2516 lines of code)
[*] Added all images and updated Replay with all male content up through day 6 (Day 7 coming once its all done.)
[*] Updated Stats screen with Mei and Jackie (Not animated yet, Want to redo all of them.)
[*] Various changes and updates in the code for stats and replay update(I think I modified every file in the game for that...)
[/list]

Plans for next weekend's update.
[list]
[*] Female route completed up to this same point.
[*] Ava fun scene for night.(Both male and female)
[*] Alex fun scene for night.(Both male and female)
[*] Finish female route variable/stats/choice updates
[*] Add female scenes to replay (I am debating on making those 2 separate sections)
[*] New Stats screen animations for all LI's
[*] And hopefully get the new menu animation done.
[/list]


To avoid having to replay the entire game if scenes are locked due to code changes, go to the about screen, their is a code section at the bottom, the code is "AlexButt" That is capital A and B, You will see a photo of Alex's Butt, Then everything should be unlocked.

notes.title: Update 7.2
notes.content:
Here is update 7.2.
Most the images used in this update were uploaded in last 2 updates, just not implemented yet, so thats why the small update size. Id say about 100 new images available in game.

Code Fixes/Changes
[olist]
[*] Re-coded Main menu for pending replay completion.
[*] Fixed/Added end of day 6/ morning day 7 rejection variable, so if you choose to not go for Alex, or you choose to not have happy time with her, you will no longer wake up with her naked.
[*]Expanded Jackie in kitchen scene on male route with choice based extended scene.
[*]Expanded Kayla in bedroom on male route, Extended ero scene, She can now reject you, and you can reject her. Several choices and stats changes.
[*]Variable's and Stats being re-implemented in day 7, I know I got behind on those, But those are coming back into play on day 7.
[*]Updated Music Screen.
[/olist]

Another update next weekend.(or early Monday morning, It's no secret at this point I work at night, So it's still sunday to me.) 
Here is what I am hoping to have ready for that update.
[list]
[*] Scene replay completed and full(With cheat code so you don't have to replay to unlock past scenes.)
[*] A few extended female route scenes.
[*] Finished pool scene and start the night fun ;)
[*] Update player stats screen, including Mei and Jackie.
[*] New Menu Background Video
[*] More uniform GUI
[/list]

The night fun...
The night stuff in day 7 is.. A lot.
You are in a house, with Kayla, Alex, Jackie, And Ava, All of wich you have varying degrees of intimacy with.
I could just force you to spend the night with a specific person (A sleep walking Alex probably.), but I would much rather give you a choice.
I may have to railroad you a bit if this takes much longer, I need to move on to day 8 officially, and that unexpected break put me behind.

notes.title: Day 7 Update 1
notes.content:
Day 7 Update 1
This is the first stage of the Day 7 updates.
As I am still working on animations this update contains about 75% of the primary male route.
This update contains 1000 images.
The majority of this day is focused on Jackie and her story arc.

I debated pushing the non animated parts to the female route, but I have a habit of when I do that, not going back and finishing them and cleaning them up, So I opted to hold off female route till animations are completed as female route has more animations then male route on day 7.

Majority of the animations for male route are at night, which is I was able to release the majority of the day, Their will be a few scenes getting expanded during the day on male route as well.

I've been working on limiting my render count, and not sure this worked out, Compared to how my normal updates are, This just seems more time compressed then my normal days, and not sure I like that.
I guess let me know what you think.

The rest of day 7 will be pushed throughout July, Expect a big majority of female content over the next week, and as day 7 is finalized, Day 8 morning content will probably show up as well as I will be working on both at the same time.

notes.title: Update 6.10
notes.content:
[b]Update 6.10[/b]

Expanded Day 6 Content.
700+ new images
2000+ new lines of code.
2 full new scenes as well as extensions to some current scenes.
Choices in day 6 have been implemented, as well as checks for previous day choices.

I wanted to get Scene replay in this update, Didn't make it in as I over slept by about 6 hours today.

I will push a small update later in the week with scene replay as well as other coding fixes/changes.
Please wait for that update before making any mods for this update, as i will be implementing some of the changes/fixes that are being done by Sancho. Mostly just things to make it easier for him to make his mod.

There was a typo in my last update when I mentioned day 7. With being on the 3 month cycle, Day 7 is meant for June 1st trough the 15th, not may.
I apologize for the typo.

Day 6 in whole has been very male route heavy, this update is no different, As day 6 is very Alex heavy, most the changes and additions were around Alex.
Female route does have the 2 new scenes, but they aren't as extensive as they are on the male route.
I am hoping to make up for this in day 7, as day 7 on female route will start with a conversation that the female route hasn't had yet with alex.

Do you need to replay day 6?
If you are going for the harem route? yes, as one of the new choices involves a more in depth conversation with Alex about Ava, and this helps lead in her into that path.
Other then that you may be able to skip the changes here, but it may cause issues later in the game if you don't replay day 6.

notes.title: Day 6 Progress report
notes.content:
Day 6 is progressing at a decent pace. A little over 1000 finalized renders for day 6 that take it to about mid day, However there is a lot of animations still rendering for the first part of the day.

The total amount of animations that will be in day 6 is not known, but as of right now, that number is over 30, and that is a combination of loops and linear (Non looped) animations.  I mentioned in the past about working with some new things for better animations. you will see that in day 6.

To give an idea of what to expect in day 6 in terms of Ero content.

Male Route:  Mei (Full Ero Content, Multiple choices.), Kayla (Mild Ero content, Multiple Choices), Ava (Full Ero Content, Multiple Choices), Alex (Not entirely sure yet, as that's later in the day, but there will be a lot of options/choices)

Female Route:  Kayla (Full Ero Content, Multiple Choices.) Ava (Kind of mild, Kind of full, Multiple Choices.) Alex (Again, Later in the day, But expect some good amount here as well.)

It is also possible that an alternate path will show up in day 6, however I am waiting to complete more of day 6's primary path before i work to much on it so it doesn't delay day 6 primary, but its looking good. This path directly involves Ava, With some side effects for both Alex(Alex's side effect is pretty intense at first) and Kayla, it is avoidable, and will have a warning when its triggered as its Ava's dark path, it's also the first trigger for "goth" Ava, There will be other goth triggers for Ava, so if you want goth Ava without the dark path, that will still be possible.

It is the first major alternate path, and I just want to make sure I can do it in a timely manner as it will have a pretty large effect for a few days in the story, resulting in scenes and content that are only available on that path, and will require some form of alterations for the remainder of the story.


[h3][b]Thank you and happy holidays[/b][/h3]
